name: Translation of the relics of St. Arcadius, monk of Vyazma and New Torzhok (1077)
life: The disciple of the Ven. Ephraim, Archimandrite of the SS. Boris and Gleb Monastery in New Torzhok, imitating his trainer, he carried out a saintly life and was revealed the paradigm of obedience. He died in peace in 1077. His relics repose in a hidden place in the SS. Boris and Gleb Monastery (see Tver Diocese).
